description: This file contains utility functions for handling LSTM modules within PyTorch's FX quantization workflow, including functions to create observed and quantized LSTM modules with custom observer configurations.

methods.name: torch.ao.nn.quantizable.LSTM _get_lstm_with_individually_observed_parts( float_lstm: torch.nn.LSTM, example_inputs: tuple[Any, ...], backend_config: BackendConfig | None = None, linear_output_obs_ctr: _PartialWrapper | None = None, sigmoid_obs_ctr: _PartialWrapper | None = None, tanh_obs_ctr: _PartialWrapper | None = None, cell_state_obs_ctr: _PartialWrapper | None = None, hidden_state_obs_ctr: _PartialWrapper | None = None, split_gates: bool = False, )
methods.description: Creates an observed, configurable LSTM module with custom observers or fake quantizes assigned to parts of the LSTM, suitable for quantization workflows.

methods.name: torch.ao.nn.quantized.LSTM _get_reference_quantized_lstm_module( observed_lstm: torch.ao.nn.quantizable.LSTM, backend_config: BackendConfig | None = None, )
methods.description: Produces a reference quantized LSTM module from an observed LSTM, removing input/output quantize/dequantize nodes, for use in custom module flow.
